data_scope: Only neutral-wall cases with independent analytical ohmic field/current checks; charged-wall targets excluded while HOLD persists
group: physical scenario (length,radius,salt,voltage,wall_offset,model); all meshes share split
split: sort physical scenario SHA256; first 7 neutral groups train, next 2 validation, remaining 3 locked test; no split changes after fitting
targets: finest original mesh current only; equilibrium zero-current groups retained
baselines: ordinary least squares with intercept and raw physical features
one-coefficient regression on physical R^2*c*V/L feature
metrics: normalized MAE by maximum abs test target; absolute tolerance for zero current
OOD: abstain for nonzero wall offset and parameter ranges beyond tested neutral grid; no claimed interpolation bound
neural_PINN: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no benefit established beyond exact analytical baseline
interpretation: Small numerical pipeline demonstration, not evidence of general charged-wall surrogate performance or experimental predictivity
